A) Ieva at the jump field

comments.text: Ieva next to stables grooms horses. And you talk to her to borrow horse for a stroll. For the first time - she directs u to Stan (who is in  the field) to take you rfirst lesson
Done: Ieva stands in front of the stable, Stan at the jump field. The borrow-a-horse talk and first lesson went to Story and Plan.
